commonSections.label: Outcome or Problem
commonSections.description: State the user, business, operational, or technical outcome and why it matters.

commonSections.label: Scope and Exclusions
commonSections.description: List what is included and explicitly excluded.

commonSections.label: Acceptance Criteria
commonSections.description: Provide measurable completion criteria, one per line.

commonSections.label: Target Repository
commonSections.description: Name the repository or repositories where delivery work belongs.

commonSections.label: Dependencies
commonSections.description: List prerequisite work, decisions, systems, and blocking relationships; write None when empty.

commonSections.label: Risks and Blockers
commonSections.description: Record known risks, blockers, and the decision or escalation needed; write None when empty.

commonSections.label: Verification and Evidence
commonSections.description: List commands, checks, reviewers, and evidence required before handoff.

types.description: A multi-feature outcome that needs decomposition and success measures.

sections.label: Strategic Objective
sections.description: Describe the durable objective and intended beneficiaries.

sections.label: Success Measures
sections.description: Define measurable outcome indicators and evaluation timing.

sections.label: Boundaries
sections.description: Define organizational, product, and architectural boundaries.

sections.label: Child Features
sections.description: List known child features or the decomposition plan.

types.description: A cohesive user or business capability with measurable acceptance.

sections.label: Users and Business Outcome
sections.description: Identify beneficiaries and the capability or outcome delivered.

sections.label: Expected Behavior
sections.description: Describe externally observable behavior and important constraints.

types.description: An issue-sized implementation, documentation, test, or operational change.

sections.label: Concrete Change
sections.description: Describe the files, systems, or behavior to change.

sections.label: Completion Conditions
sections.description: State the conditions that make the task ready for handoff.

types.description: An unexpected or incorrect behavior requiring reproduction and regression evidence.

sections.label: Observed Behavior
sections.description: Describe what happens, including exact errors when safe.

sections.label: Expected Behavior
sections.description: Describe the correct behavior.

sections.label: Reproduction
sections.description: Provide deterministic reproduction steps and frequency.

sections.label: Environment
sections.description: Record relevant versions, platform, configuration, and data conditions without secrets.

sections.label: Impact and Severity
sections.description: Describe affected users or systems and justify severity.

sections.label: Regression Evidence
sections.description: Identify the regression test or evidence that will prevent recurrence.

types.description: A bounded investigation that produces evidence and a decision rather than production scope.

sections.label: Decision Question
sections.description: State the single decision or uncertainty this spike resolves.

sections.label: Effort Box
sections.description: Set a fixed investigation limit and stopping condition.

sections.label: Investigation Approach
sections.description: List experiments, prototypes, sources, and comparisons.

sections.label: Decision Artifact
sections.description: Name the expected recommendation, ADR, prototype, or evidence report.

types.description: An active or resolved service disruption tracked through recovery and follow-up.

sections.label: Severity and Impact
sections.description: State affected users, systems, regions, and business impact.

sections.label: Detection and Current State
sections.description: Record detection time, signal, owner, and present state.

sections.label: Timeline
sections.description: Record material events and decisions in chronological order.

sections.label: Mitigation and Recovery
sections.description: Describe containment, recovery, validation, and rollback readiness.

sections.label: Follow-up Work
sections.description: List corrective bugs, changes, and learning actions.

types.description: A potential event or condition requiring ownership, mitigation, and contingency.

sections.label: Risk Statement
sections.description: Describe the cause, uncertain event, and consequence.

sections.label: Probability and Impact
sections.description: Assess likelihood, impact, and rationale.

sections.label: Trigger and Owner
sections.description: Name observable triggers and the accountable human owner.

sections.label: Mitigation and Contingency
sections.description: Describe preventive actions and the response if the risk occurs.

types.description: A controlled production, infrastructure, data, or process modification.

sections.label: Reason and Affected Systems
sections.description: Explain why the change is needed and what it can affect.

sections.label: Rollout Plan
sections.description: Provide sequencing, ownership, observation, and pause criteria.

sections.label: Rollback Plan
sections.description: Provide tested reversal steps and the rollback decision threshold.

sections.label: Approval and Change Window
sections.description: Record required human approval and the authorized execution window.

types.description: A small user-valued story shaped for test-first continuous integration.

sections.label: User Story
sections.description: State the persona, capability, and benefit.

sections.label: Acceptance Tests
sections.description: Describe executable or observable examples before implementation.

sections.label: Test-First Plan
sections.description: Identify the first failing test or why automation is impractical.

sections.label: CI and Refactoring Evidence
sections.description: Name fresh CI evidence and the green baseline required before refactoring.

types.description: A smallest-batch improvement aimed at measurable flow or value.

sections.label: Current Condition and Waste
sections.description: Describe the observed condition, waiting, rework, handoff, or excess batch.

sections.label: Desired Condition and Measure
sections.description: State the measurable change in value or flow.

sections.label: Smallest Change
sections.description: Define the smallest issue-sized intervention and deferred scope.

sections.label: Follow-up Decision
sections.description: Define when to adopt, adapt, stop, or escalate.

types.description: A bounded hypothesis test with measures and explicit decision criteria.

sections.label: Hypothesis
sections.description: State the predicted outcome and causal belief.

sections.label: Measure and Guardrails
sections.description: Define success measures, safety guardrails, and evidence sources.

sections.label: Experiment Bounds
sections.description: Set the smallest batch, capacity limit, duration, and stop conditions.

sections.label: Decision Rule
sections.description: Define adoption, adaptation, rejection, and escalation criteria.

types.description: A small client-valued feature within Subject Area and Business Activity hierarchy.

sections.label: Subject Area and Business Activity
sections.description: Record Subject Area and Business Activity, AOK's canonical feature-set term.

sections.label: Feature ID and Canonical Name
sections.description: Provide the feature ID and a name accepted by the FDD grammar.

sections.label: Parsed Name Parts
sections.description: Record action, result, preposition, object, style, and article when classic.

sections.label: Estimated Effort Days
sections.description: Estimate one through ten days; split larger features.

sections.label: Model and Feature-List Membership
sections.description: Link the overall model and approved feature-list entry.

sections.label: Feature Milestones
sections.description: Record evidence for Domain Walkthrough, Design, Design Inspection, Code, Code Inspection, and Promote to Build.

types.description: An outcome-focused requirement prioritized across project, increment, and timebox.

sections.label: Requirement ID, Theme, and Outcome
sections.description: Record the identifier, optional theme, and normalized outcome.

sections.label: MoSCoW Priorities
sections.description: Record project priority and paired increment/timebox priorities where applicable.

sections.label: Project Increment and Timebox
sections.description: Name assigned increments and timeboxes without treating them as feature hierarchies.

sections.label: Ownership and Business Acceptance
sections.description: Name the owner and the human Business Ambassador acceptance required.

types.description: An actor-goal interaction selected into an AUP iteration.

sections.label: Work-Item ID, Outcome, and Priority
sections.description: Record the typed requirement ID, concise outcome, priority, and current status.

sections.label: Iteration Link and Objective
sections.description: Record iteration ID, lifecycle stage, and objective.

sections.label: Actor, Trigger, and Main Flow
sections.description: Describe the actor goal, trigger, preconditions, and main success flow.

sections.label: Alternate and Failure Flows
sections.description: Describe material alternate paths and failure handling.

sections.label: Discipline Implications
sections.description: Identify Model, Implementation, Test, Deployment, Configuration Management, Project Management, and Environment implications.

types.description: A user-valued story selected into an AUP iteration.

sections.label: Work-Item ID, Outcome, and Priority
sections.description: Record the typed requirement ID, concise outcome, priority, and current status.

sections.label: Iteration Link and Objective
sections.description: Record iteration ID, lifecycle stage, and objective.

sections.label: Role, Capability, and Benefit
sections.description: State who needs what capability and why.

sections.label: Discipline Implications
sections.description: Identify implications across all seven AUP disciplines.

types.description: A measurable quality or constraint requirement selected into an AUP iteration.

sections.label: Work-Item ID, Outcome, and Priority
sections.description: Record the typed requirement ID, concise outcome, priority, and current status.

sections.label: Iteration Link and Objective
sections.description: Record iteration ID, lifecycle stage, and objective.

sections.label: Quality Attribute and Context
sections.description: Name the quality attribute, operating context, stimulus, and affected response.

sections.label: Measure and Threshold
sections.description: Define a measurable threshold and verification method.

sections.label: Discipline Implications
sections.description: Identify implications across all seven AUP disciplines.

types.description: A business constraint or decision rule selected into an AUP iteration.

sections.label: Work-Item ID, Outcome, and Priority
sections.description: Record the typed requirement ID, concise outcome, priority, and current status.

sections.label: Iteration Link and Objective
sections.description: Record iteration ID, lifecycle stage, and objective.

sections.label: Rule and Rationale
sections.description: State the normative rule, source, and business rationale.

sections.label: Examples and Exceptions
sections.description: Provide confirming examples, boundary cases, and authorized exceptions.

sections.label: Discipline Implications
sections.description: Identify implications across all seven AUP disciplines.

types.description: An observed defect selected into an AUP iteration with discipline evidence.

sections.label: Work-Item ID, Outcome, and Priority
sections.description: Record the typed defect ID, concise outcome, priority, and current status.

sections.label: Iteration Link and Objective
sections.description: Record iteration ID, lifecycle stage, and objective.

sections.label: Observed, Expected, and Reproduction
sections.description: Record observed and expected behavior, reproduction, environment, and impact.

sections.label: Discipline Implications
sections.description: Identify implications across all seven AUP disciplines.

types.description: Architecture, environment, configuration, or implementation work selected into an AUP iteration.

sections.label: Work-Item ID, Outcome, and Priority
sections.description: Record the typed technical-work ID, concise outcome, priority, and current status.

sections.label: Iteration Link and Objective
sections.description: Record iteration ID, lifecycle stage, and objective.

sections.label: Technical Objective and Rationale
sections.description: Describe the technical outcome, constraints, and delivery rationale.

sections.label: Discipline Implications
sections.description: Identify implications across all seven AUP disciplines.
